records.title: Create and approve an AI incident response playbook
records.definition_of_done: Approved playbook with named roles, severity criteria, containment steps, evidence preservation, root-cause review and recurrence-prevention actions; validated by tabletop exercise.

records.title: Implement a human-in-the-loop approval gate for consequential outputs
records.definition_of_done: Documented approval gate, defined override and suspension authority, tested mechanism and retained review evidence.

records.title: Publish a controlled model card and user guidance
records.definition_of_done: Controlled model card and user guidance covering intended use, capabilities, limitations, known failure modes, data characteristics and required user training.

records.title: Implement clinical human oversight and safe override controls
records.definition_of_done: Approved policy and procedure requiring qualified clinician review before significant AI-supported diagnostic decisions; tested pause, interrupt and override mechanism; test evidence documented before pilot launch.

records.title: Create an AI-specific incident response and escalation procedure
records.definition_of_done: Extended Policy 8.2 or linked AI incident standard covering harm scenarios, roles, escalation thresholds, containment, records, root-cause review and recurrence prevention; validated by tabletop exercise before pilot launch.

records.title: Establish an AI transparency and system documentation standard
records.definition_of_done: Approved lifecycle documentation standard covering purpose, users, capabilities, limitations, training-data characteristics, reliable-use context, risks, ownership, review cadence and a stakeholder-accessible repository.
